title: Skydive Toronto Inc.
specs: Most popular tandem jump at 12,250 feet with 45 seconds freefall
Media packages filmed in 4K with multiple edited videos and photos
Facilities include large indoor packing area, lounge, kitchen, washrooms, and showers
Minimum age 16 with parental consent for tandem; 18 for solo jumps
Maximum weight 280 lbs for tandem; additional fee over 249 lbs and reservation required for weekends
Medical clearance recommended for tandem jumpers over 70 years old
Zero tolerance for alcohol and drugs 8 hours before jump and during operations
Glasses and contact lenses allowed with special goggles
Can accommodate groups of any size; call to arrange

blurb: Guests board an aircraft and climb to altitude before exiting for a freefall at speeds of 200 km/h. Tandem skydiving includes a five-minute canopy ride with panoramic views. Media packages with photos and videos are available for purchase.
extraNote: All payments are non-refundable but never expire and can be used during operational season · Bookings may be transferred to another person but not combined · Rescheduling allowed up to 24 hours before reservation · Operations dependent on weather; no jumps in rain, snow, hail, or low clouds · Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays in early spring; 5 days a week from May to September; limited weekends in late fall; closed in winter
